title: To an unknown woman
date: '1901-03-01'

from-name: Charlotte Mary Yonge
from-address: Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester
to-name: To an unknown woman
manuscript-location: MS Seymour Public Library, Auburn, New York

Dear Madam
I have desired a few of my village books to be sent to you - I cannot do more as I have a good deal on my hands here, and all the books suitable for giving away are absorbed by needs at hand

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: The transcription was kindly supplied by Mr Stephen C.

Erskine, the Librarian.

If the date is correct it is a very late letter indeed since CMY died on 24 March.

It is uncharacteristic of her to give only the month.
